_comment: RIGHTBREED v4 — G1 climate risk gate. DRAFT, PENDING VET SIGN-OFF.
This file is deliberately data, not code: a vet can re-class a breed or
re-tune a multiplier here without a redeploy of the scoring logic.
Every breed in breeds.json must appear in `breeds` or the build FAILS
(scripts/validate-data.mjs). Multipliers are applied to the base score:
final = base x G1 x G2 x G3. Any G1 <= heatFlagThreshold raises a HEAT flag.
OPEN QUESTION for the vets: Boxer + Rottweiler are currently HEAT_SENSITIVE
(0.55 in hot-humid) — confirm whether they belong at 0.40 instead.

classReasons.HEAT_OK: tolerates Indian heat with shade and water
classReasons.HEAT_SENSITIVE: a heavy or double coat traps heat
classReasons.BRACHYCEPHALIC: a flat face prevents effective panting
classReasons.ARCTIC_HEAVY_COAT: bred for snow, cannot shed heat
